title: Stability AI发布新音频模型 可创作6分钟歌曲
content: Stability Audio 3.0小型模型可以在设备上运行并生成两分钟长的曲目。
original_title: Stability AI releases a new audio model that can create 6-minute songs

title: NanoClaw 创建者拒绝了 2000 万美元的收购要约，转而筹集了 1200 万美元的种子资金
content: NanoClaw 是作为 OpenClaw 的安全替代品而创建的，旨在协助科恩兄弟的人工智能营销公司，该公司使用代理来完成大部分工作。但 NanoClaw 不是直接在计算机上运行，​​而是在容器中沙盒运行。
original_title: NanoClaw creator turns down $20M buyout offer, raises $12M seed instead
original_content: NanoClaw was created as a secure alternative to OpenClaw to assist the Cohen brothers with their AI marketing firm that used agents to do much of the work. But instead of running directly on a computer, NanoClaw runs sandboxed in a container.

title: 我给了我的 OpenClaw 特工一个实体
content: 人工智能模型的编码技能将使机器人的构建和部署变得更加容易。
original_title: I Gave My OpenClaw Agent a Physical Body
original_content: The coding skills of AI models are about to make it much easier to build and deploy robots.

title: Google I/O 2026 上公布的一切：Gemini、搜索、智能眼镜
content: 谷歌正在完善其 Gemini 模型，改进搜索，并在一切领域启用人工智能代理。今年秋天还将推出一些漂亮的新型智能眼镜。
original_title: Everything Announced at Google I/O 2026: Gemini, Search, Smart Glasses
original_content: Google is sprucing up its Gemini models, revamping search, and enabling AI agents in everything. There are also some spiffy new smart glasses coming this fall.

title: Gemini Spark 是 Google 对 OpenClaw 24/7 AI Agent 的回应
content: 谷歌始终运行、需要大量数据的人工智能代理旨在花你的钱并发送你的电子邮件。
original_title: Gemini Spark Is Google’s Response to OpenClaw’s 24/7 AI Agent
original_content: Google’s always-running, data-hungry AI agent is designed to spend your money and send your emails.
